successCriteria.description: A login operation exists that, given a valid email + password, returns a signed JWT whose verified payload has `sub` equal to the employee id and `role` equal to the employee role, plus the employee profile with `passwordHash`/`password_hash` absent.
Wrong email, wrong password, and a null stored password hash are indistinguishable: each produces a single UnauthorizedError with message 'Invalid email or password' (status 401, code UNAUTHORIZED).
The login route parses the wire body as unknown and rejects missing/non-string/empty `email` or `password` with a ValidationError (status 400, code VALIDATION_ERROR) — never via an unchecked cast.
'/auth/login' is added to PUBLIC_PATHS so the endpoint is reachable without a bearer token, while the token contract (sub/role) and signToken/verifyToken semantics are unchanged.

constraints: Use only bcrypt (^5.0.1) and jsonwebtoken (^8.5.1) already in package.json — no new libraries.
The token payload must be produced via signToken({ id, role }) from src/shared/auth; do not re-implement signing or alter the sub/role contract.
Never return passwordHash/password_hash in any response body — the returned employee must be stripped of it.
Do not mount authRoutes in src/app.ts in this phase (deferred to Phase 7).
Follow the no-any rule: parse request.body as unknown with type guards, not `request.body as SomeDto`.
outOfScope: Token refresh, logout, password reset/change, and registration endpoints.
Changing the JWT token contract (sub/role) or signToken/verifyToken semantics.

entityInvariants.invariant: login(email, password) resolves to { token, employee } only when the email exists AND passwordHash is non-null AND bcrypt.compare is true; any other credential state throws UnauthorizedError('Invalid email or password').
The employee returned from login is the profile with passwordHash stripped; password_hash must never appear in any response body.

interfaceConstraints.operation: login(email: string, password: string): Promise<{ token: string; employee: Employee }>
interfaceConstraints.authRule: Public (unauthenticated) — reachable without a bearer token via PUBLIC_PATHS.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: NotFoundError, null passwordHash, and bcrypt mismatch all collapse to UnauthorizedError('Invalid email or password') (401/UNAUTHORIZED); invalid body → ValidationError (400/VALIDATION_ERROR).

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Token payload must match what verifyToken reads: signToken({ id: employee.id, role: employee.role }) so `sub` = id and `role` = role.
Error mapping must reuse the AppError → { error, code } shape with correct status (sendError pattern).
Employee lookup must go through IEmployeeService.getEmployeeByEmail, which throws NotFoundError when absent.
Use UnauthorizedError and ValidationError from the shared error contract (status 401/400, codes UNAUTHORIZED/VALIDATION_ERROR).

integrationPoints.why: signToken for minting the token and PUBLIC_PATHS for making login reachable without a token.
IEmployeeService.getEmployeeByEmail and the Employee model for credential lookup and profile return.
UnauthorizedError and ValidationError for credential and body-validation failures.
